context: Riku-teen and Sho-young trade soccer cards; negotiate carefully.
purpose: Two teens engaged in trade-style interaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 陸くん、このカード、交換しよ!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded enthusiasm. Quick tempo, energized opening. The eager lean-in of a six-year-old who's found something exciting. Warm and direct, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: What kind are you looking for?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, fully present. Warm attention without patronizing. Slightly slower pace — making room for Sho to think. Soft eye contact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 違ったレアカード、出てきた!
lines.en: I got a different rare one!
lines.style: Pure delight breaking through. Slight breathless rush on the opening. High energy but genuine, not performed. The kind of joy that spills out naturally.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うまく、二枚と交換するか。
lines.en: Could swap it for two of mine, yeah?
lines.style: Thoughtful, fair-minded. A beat of calculation sits light in the tone — Riku working through what's honest. Warm but steady, not eager to close the deal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Satisfied agreement. Soft, genuine contentment. No performance — just relief that the deal works for both of them. Warm exhale on the closing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 相手の希望、聞くの、大事やな。
lines.en: Listening to what the other person wants — that's what matters.
lines.style: Quiet realization. Soft, reflective tone. Not lecturing — just noticing something true out loud. The kind of thing Riku says when he's thinking past the moment itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、お互い、ええ取引やな!
lines.en: Yeah, that's a good trade for both of us!
lines.style: Warm affirmation. Bright but grounded. Sho echoing the fairness back, pleased at the rightness of it. Natural, unselfconscious joy.
